question: What should come in the place of blank number (4)?
solution:
The correct answer is '**mechanical**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage warns of the "ethical stakes" of treating health purely as something "measurable."
 
• The following sentence explains that "the ineffable" human experiences like "pain, anxiety, even trust" are ignored in a model that only cares about "what can be graphed."
 
• "**Mechanical**" perfectly captures this negative consequence: by reducing human health to pure data points and algorithms, it is stripped of its humanity, feeling, and complexity, becoming machine-like.
